choices.code: return [value for value in nums for _ in range(2)]
choices.feedback: This uses “return [value for value in nums for _ in range(2)]” instead of “return nums + nums”. On this test, it returns [1,1,2,2,1,1]; the expected result is [1,2,1,1,2,1].
